prerequisites.text: You must have a valid Utah hunting or combination license to apply for a permit, bonus point or preference point (you can buy it while applying).
prerequisites.quote: You must have a valid hunting or combination license to apply. If needed, you can buy a license at the same time you submit your application.

prerequisites.text: If born after Dec. 31, 1965, you must show proof of hunter education before you can apply for or get a hunting license or big game permit (Trial Hunting Program is the only exception).
prerequisites.quote: If you were born after Dec. 31, 1965, you must provide proof that you've passed a hunter education course approved by the division before you can apply for or obtain a hunting license or a big game permit.

prerequisites.text: Waiting periods: limited-entry buck deer and bull elk 5 years, buck pronghorn 2 years. Bull moose, bison, bighorn sheep and mountain goat are once in a lifetime.
prerequisites.quote: The waiting period for limited-entry buck deer is five years. The bull elk waiting period is five years. The waiting period for buck pronghorn is two years.

prerequisites.text: Residents may apply for one limited-entry and one once-in-a-lifetime species (permit or bonus point) per year; nonresidents may apply for all limited-entry and once-in-a-lifetime species. Only one limited-entry or once-in-a-lifetime permit can be drawn per year.
prerequisites.quote: Please remember that you may draw only one limited-entry or once-in-a-lifetime permit each year.

prerequisites.text: Sportsman permits are for Utah residents only; applicants for big game must turn 12 by Dec. 31, 2027 and hold a valid Utah hunting or combination license.
prerequisites.quote: only Utah residents may apply for sportsman permits ... A valid Utah hunting or combination license is also required to apply

notes: The 2027 main big game and antlerless draw dates are not posted yet (checked 2026-11-04); the 2027 Big Game Application Guidebook is not out (the guidebooks page lists 2026 as current). Main and antlerless draws are recorded with 2026 dates as last_year. Only the 2027 resident sportsman-permit draw has published 2027 dates (Oct. 20 - Nov. 10, 2026). Utah has no separate point-only window: points are bought by applying during the main (Mar-Apr) or antlerless (June) application periods. Fees are the 2026 schedule from the 2026 guidebooks; nonresident fee increases took effect July 1, 2025 (licenses) and Sept. 1, 2025 (permits/application fees). A 2.2% card transaction fee applies. The agency fee web page (wildlife.utah.gov/licenses/fees) was not fetched; guidebook tables were used. Bison, CWMU and Dedicated Hunter details left out except where noted.
